title: Deep Learning-Driven High-Throughput High-Resolution TEM Analysis of Surface Characteristics during Nanocrystal Growth
content: Understanding the surface characteristics of nanoparticles is crucial, as surface atoms govern key properties such as catalytic activity, stability, and electronic behavior. Surface morphology, particularly features like curvature and facet exposure, directly influences reactivity by altering surface energy, which in turn affects adsorption and desorption behavior of reactants in catalysis. While bulk characterization methods provide valuable insights into overall composition and structure, they often fail to capture the fine-scale variations in surface geometry that dictate functional performance. A precise understanding of surface features at the nanoscale is therefore essential for advancing material design and optimizing synthesis strategies.
